objective: Measure the model-KLD effect of each frozen layer-60 candidate expert without assuming that local complete-expert error predicts its model effect. Six experts contain accepted reconstructed-activation refits; experts 186 and 180 retain their uniform-K3 down endpoints after the local fallback rule rejected their refits.
evidence_boundary: The 16 public 512-token documents are candidate-selection data for this plan. A singleton or later composition selected with these documents requires confirmation on a new document-disjoint reference tier.

selection_protocol.retention_rule: Retain a singleton only when candidate-minus-resident equal-document mean KLD is negative on both document groups. Rank retained singletons by the mean over all 16 documents.
selection_protocol.composition_boundary: A composition chosen from singleton results is another selection candidate and requires a new document-disjoint confirmation tier.
